_comment: Fragment 25 — D-68, Q11 deferred past S1; G64 opened for the NFR-03 inference conflict. Merged 2026-08-21.

nodes.label: D-68 — Q11 Deferred Past S1
nodes.description: Chief Editor decision of 2026-08-21. Q11, the field naming for the independence mechanism, is deferred past S1. Q11 stays open — a deferral is a scheduling choice, not a closure, and the count of outstanding Chief Editor decisions is unchanged. No field name, field shape, or enum value is decided.
nodes.rationale: Recorded as decided rather than left implicit, because the deferral has consequences that only appear once it is written down. 0002 was already blocked by Q10 alone under G16, so the deferral costs no schedule time — a cost that is easy to overstate.

nodes.label: Deferring Q11 Selects the Boolean by Default
nodes.description: The sprint plan's S1 migration line already instructs the fallback: pending confirmation, write line_boundary_crossed and identity_assurance instead. That line is the instrument an executor actually reads, so deferring Q11 does not leave the field undecided — it selects the boolean shape by default, with no decision recorded against it.
nodes.rationale: The inverse of the sprint plan's own section 11 constraint, which says a finding is not routed until it appears in an instrument executed against. Here an unrouted decision is being executed by default. Recorded because nothing previously stated that deferral had a default outcome at all.

nodes.label: G64 — Three States Do Not Fit in a Boolean
nodes.description: FR-05 defines three independence states: satisfied when Line 1 and Line 2 are crossed, not_applicable within a Line, and override_not_four_eyes outside the target Line. AC-07 drafts line_boundary_crossed as a boolean. G-02 counts crossings without Line separation while excluding logged overrides, so it needs two distinct false-states. A boolean has one, and recovering the second requires reading event_type alongside it — inference at read.
nodes.rationale: NFR-03 reads never null, never inferred at read. Q11's row concedes only the null clause and calls for NFR-03 to be rewritten for it. The inference clause is a second conflict that no document recorded. Must resolve before the 0002 draft is written under G27 at S0, which is earlier than Q11's own row implies, because the draft is the first moment a field name is committed to text an executor will apply.

nodes.label: line_separation Is the Vocabulary Already in Use
nodes.description: Not decided, recorded so the work is not redone. G-02 already describes the metric as crossings without Line separation. If the field holds three states, line_boundary_crossed is a boolean's name carrying an enum, and not_applicable reads as nonsense against crossed.
nodes.rationale: A naming candidate drawn from the documents' own words rather than invented, consistent with the project's repeated finding that unfamiliar labels usually map to existing vocabulary rather than to new structure.

nodes.label: identity_assurance Is Load-Bearing, Not Scope Creep
nodes.description: Version 1 is demo-first with no login wall, and TC1 leaves the anon key public, so every v1 actor identity is self-asserted. NFR-02 makes workflow_transitions append-only, so rows written before authentication ships can never be re-marked afterwards, and inferring them from a timestamp would be inference at read again.
nodes.rationale: Verified rather than assumed, because a second column in an append-only table is exactly the kind of addition that looks like scope creep until the alternative is checked. The alternative is a permanent inability to distinguish pre-authentication rows from post-authentication ones.
